module_title: Marriage as the Path to Human Flourishing
doctrinal_focus: Marriage is the primary infrastructure for human flourishing (eudaemonia). Civilization depends on covenant marriages built on teleios maturity.
learning_objectives: Define eudaemonia as teleios living (wholeness, fruitfulness, steady goodness)
Reject romanticized marriage models in favor of covenant theology
Identify the four movements of Genesis 2:24 (leave, cleave, one flesh, nakedness)
Assess personal maturity using Hebrews 5:14 framework (full age)
Practice FROM perfection (justified identity, not performance anxiety)
core_teachings: Marriage produces wholeness when properly formed
One-flesh union requires two whole persons (not 0.5 + 0.5)

design_frameworks.title: Eudaemonia Progression Map
design_frameworks.description: Visual map showing how wholeness → marriage → family → civilization

design_frameworks.title: Genesis 2:24 Four Movements
design_frameworks.description: Leave → Cleave → One Flesh → Not Ashamed pathway

design_frameworks.title: Marriage as Infrastructure Diagram
design_frameworks.description: How marriage functions as societal foundation (UDHR 16)

lessons.title: What is Eudaemonia? The Crisis of Clarity
objectives: Understand why clarity about marriage has declined
key_concepts: Confusion has multiplied while clarity has grown scarce

lessons.title: Dianoetic Modus Ponens: Come, Let Us Reason

drill.title: Isaiah 1:18 - Reasoned Faith
drill.instructions: Read Isaiah 1:18 five times slowly. Journal: How does God invite us to reason? Why does SBD use logic alongside Scripture?

objectives: Distinguish between cultural trends and biblical design
Practice reasoning from Scripture + Nature + Logic
key_concepts: Scripture (revealed Word) + Nature (created order) + Logic (sound reasoning)
Rejecting cultural trends in favor of design principles
Faith and reason are allies, not enemies

lessons.title: Design vs. Default: Male and Female by Creation

drill.title: Personal Design Inventory
drill.instructions: Answer: How do I currently view male/female differences? Where have I absorbed cultural lies? What does Genesis 1:27 require of my thinking?

objectives: Reject gender ideology in favor of created order
key_concepts: Two sexes by creation, not spectrum by construction
Image of God expressed in male AND female

lessons.title: The One-Flesh Mystery: Genesis 2:24-25

drill.title: Genesis 2:24-25 Journaling
drill.instructions: Handwrite Genesis 2:24-25. Underline 'one flesh' and 'not ashamed'. Journal: What do these require of me personally? What preparation is needed before I can experience this?

objectives: Identify four movements: Leave, Cleave, One Flesh, Nakedness
Understand covenant (not contract) as marriage foundation
key_concepts: One Flesh = sexual union in covenant
Not Ashamed = innocence stewarded, not lost

lessons.title: Maturity Required: Full Age Before Vows

drill.title: Hebrews 5:14 Maturity Audit
drill.instructions: Rate yourself 1-10 in: Self-command, Steadiness, Empathy, Discernment. Identify your weakest area. Write one specific action plan to strengthen it.

objectives: Understand why maturity precedes marriage vows
key_concepts: Full age = self-command + steadiness + empathy + discernment
Maturity is trained, not automatic with age
Marriage reveals maturity deficits; formation must precede vows

lessons.title: Practice FROM Perfection: Identity and Action

drill.title: Romans 3:24 Identity Statement
drill.instructions: Write your identity statement based on Romans 3:24. Complete this sentence: 'I am justified freely by grace. Therefore, I practice _______ FROM that perfection, not TO earn it.' Share with spouse or accountability partner.

objectives: Begin practicing FROM perfection instead of TO perfection
key_concepts: Justified freely = already made righteous in Christ
Practice flows FROM secure identity, not performance anxiety
Teleios = returning to your created wholeness, not earning it

formation_drills.title: Personal Flourishing Audit
formation_drills.instructions: Answer these questions honestly: (1) In what areas of life am I flourishing (whole, abundant, steady, good)? (2) Where am I fragmenting or chaotic? (3) How does my marriage (current or future) reflect my level of personal wholeness? (4) What ONE area needs urgent formation?

formation_drills.title: Marriage Worldview Reset
formation_drills.instructions: Write 300-500 words: How has culture lied to me about marriage? What romantic myths have I believed? What does eudaemonia-centered marriage require that I've avoided?

marriage_execution.title: Write Your Marriage Mission Statement
marriage_execution.instructions: With your spouse, write a 1-paragraph mission statement answering: Why did God give us this marriage? What is our covenant purpose? How will we build civilization through our home?

marriage_execution.title: Draft Pre-Marriage Mission Statement
marriage_execution.instructions: With your fiancé(e), draft a mission statement answering: Why are we getting married? What covenant objectives will guide our home? How will our marriage serve God's purposes?

marriage_execution.title: Personal Covenant Vision
marriage_execution.instructions: Write your personal vision for future marriage: What kind of spouse do I aspire to be? What covenant values will I bring? How am I preparing NOW for covenant responsibility?
marriage_execution.validation: Share with mentor or accountability partner

marriage_execution.title: Define Your Covenant Objectives (Next 90 Days)
marriage_execution.instructions: Together, identify 3 covenant objectives for next 90 days. Examples: Weekly check-ins, monthly date nights, daily blessings, sexual intimacy frequency, financial stewardship goals.

pics_and_pearls_practice.prompt: This week, simply notice: What images dominated your imagination? Sexual? Romantic? Fantasy? No judgment yet—just awareness. List 5-7 images/scenarios that captured your mind's attention.
pics_and_pearls_practice.instructions: Pics & Pearls begins with awareness, not condemnation. Notice what fills your imagination without shame. This is data collection for future governance.

reflection_prompts.question: How has culture lied to you about marriage? List 3 specific lies you've believed.
In your own words, what does flourishing (eudaemonia) look like in your home? Be concrete—not vague feelings, but specific patterns.
After completing the Hebrews 5:14 maturity audit, what is your weakest area? What specific evidence from your life proves this? What ONE action will you take this week to strengthen it?
React to this statement: 'Your spouse is not your better half; they are your better whole.' Agree? Disagree? Why? What does this require of you?
Who will you share your maturity assessment with for honest feedback? When will you ask them? Write their name and set a date.

components.question: Eudaemonia means:
components.explanation: Eudaemonia (Greek) = human flourishing—wholeness, abundance, steadiness, goodness. Not mere happiness or feelings.

components.question: According to UDHR Article 16:3, the family is:
options: the fundamental group unit of society
components.correct: the fundamental group unit of society
components.explanation: UDHR 16:3 declares family as the fundamental group unit of society, entitled to protection. Marriage → Family → Society → Civilization.

components.question: The four movements of Genesis 2:24 are:
options: Leave, Cleave, One Flesh, Not Ashamed
components.correct: Leave, Cleave, One Flesh, Not Ashamed
components.explanation: Genesis 2:24-25 shows four movements: Leave (maturity), Cleave (covenant), One Flesh (sexual union), Not Ashamed (innocence stewarded).

components.question: 'Full age' (Hebrews 5:14) refers to:
options: maturity with self-command, steadiness, empathy, discernment
components.correct: maturity with self-command, steadiness, empathy, discernment
components.explanation: Full age = teleios maturity (Hebrews 5:14)—trained capacities, not chronological time or emotional feelings.

components.question: Practice FROM Perfection (Romans 3:24) means:
options: I must perform perfectly to earn God's acceptance
I practice FROM my justified identity, not TO earn righteousness
Perfection is impossible, so don't try
components.correct: I practice FROM my justified identity, not TO earn righteousness
components.explanation: Romans 3:24 = justified freely by grace. Practice flows FROM that secure identity, not performance anxiety to earn worth.

components.question: Explain why marriage is infrastructure, not just emotion. Use the logic chain from Module 1. (100-200 words)
What is the difference between 0.5 + 0.5 = 1 (cultural lie) and 1 + 1 = One Flesh (biblical design)? Why does this matter? (100-150 words)
rubric: Defines cultural lie: two incomplete people hoping to be completed
Defines biblical design: two whole persons entering covenant
Explains crushing expectations vs. realistic covenant

components.question: Define teleios and explain how it applies to marriage preparation. (75-125 words)
rubric: Explains teleios as trained capacity (not sinlessness)

components.task: Submit your Marriage Mission Statement (married/engaged) OR Personal Covenant Vision (single)
rubric: Biblical grounding: References Scripture or SBD principles
Specificity: Not vague, includes concrete commitments
Covenant orientation: Focuses on giving, not getting

components.task: Submit your Pics & Pearls Week 1 journal entry (5+ imagery observations)
rubric: Specificity: Named actual images/scenarios, not vague
Awareness: Shows noticing without judgment yet

mastery_check.mastery_statement: By completing this assessment, you demonstrate understanding of: eudaemonia as human flourishing, marriage as civilization infrastructure, Genesis 2:24 covenant design, teleios maturity requirements, and Practice FROM Perfection theology. You are ready for Module 2.

common_struggles: Students confuse emotional readiness with covenant capacity
Resistance to teleios language (sounds too theological)
Difficulty accepting marriage as infrastructure (feels impersonal)
Pics & Pearls Week 1 requires privacy assurance (many fear judgment)
teaching_emphasis: Eudaemonia is NOT self-help—it's biblical anthropology
Practice FROM Perfection prevents performance anxiety
Genesis 2:24 is sequence: Leave → Cleave → One Flesh (order matters)
UDHR 16:3 connects personal marriage to public good

grading_guidelines.mission_statement: Look for covenant orientation (giving, not getting), biblical grounding, specificity
grading_guidelines.maturity_assessment: Honest self-evaluation matters more than high scores
grading_guidelines.pics_pearls: Grade on completion only—privacy is essential for honesty
grading_guidelines.short_answers: Require biblical citations or SBD terminology—no vague spirituality
